basis: Keeps the raw byte stream as an admissible mode and tests reversible page-order transforms that can be restored by sorting decoded page blocks back by their unique sorted page ids. No explicit permutation metadata is stored.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary
description: Lossless one-byte rate-ledger selector over raw FX2-SC and several reversible page-order modes, backed by the byte-split/direct/extra/page-match FX2-SC binary.
expected_use: Screen at 1MB, then promote only if the selected page-order mode beats the raw FX2-SC archive by more than the mode tag and counted wrapper growth at the same scope.
